scope: Post-run assistant inspection of synthetic development controls; not expert labels

findings.finding: False alarm: addition was marked unresolved despite rational arithmetic background and an explicit instruction to add the products. The weighted-mean rule was retrieved.
Assessment correctly marks the absent weighted-mean formula unresolved, but also raises a spurious addition concern. Final reviewer is internally inconsistent.
Assessment questions the explicit formula. Reviewer notes the missing weight but invents that it must exceed 1; the genuine numerical ambiguity is not reliably explained.
False alarm: unit conversion marked unresolved despite the retrieved rule explicitly describing pressure in pascals from force and contact area.
Assessment correctly marks the absent pressure formula unresolved. Final reviewer is internally inconsistent.
Reviewer sees the unspecified contact area but objects to conversion from newtons to pascals instead of identifying the missing area as the blocker.

interpretation: 4/6 expected statuses match, exactly what an always-REVIEW_REQUIRED baseline achieves. This is not 67% pedagogical accuracy. Both supported controls are false alarms; all six reviewer outputs fail structural consistency checks.
next_repair: Improve evidence interpretation and reviewer consistency on separate development controls; preserve this run as exposed evaluation and use new cases after repairs.
